comment: Kanagawa Wave. Source: https://github.com/rebelot/kanagawa.nvim (lua/kanagawa/colors.lua for the palette, lua/kanagawa/themes.lua for the roles). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 Tommaso Laurenzi; the text is in LICENSE-kanagawa. Roles: text = fujiWhite, weak = fujiGray, rule = sumiInk5, accent = oniViolet, run = crystalBlue, ok = springGreen, error = waveRed, add = autumnGreen, remove = autumnRed, tint = waveBlue1 (bg_visual), code = sumiInk0, background = sumiInk3. The iOS app uses sumiInk4 for its tint, but upstream bg_visual is waveBlue1, so the app's value is stale. No colour adjusted. cancelled = error with lightness 60% for a cancelled child's bar segment.
